result.summary: Found 1 clear visual/content defect: an untranslated localization key is exposed as a section heading. Excluded edge-clipped carousel items and bottom viewport cutoff per instructions.

issues.description: A section heading displays the raw localization key "home_feed.popular_title" instead of user-facing copy, making the UI look unfinished/broken.
issues.suggestion: Fix the missing translation/localization fallback so the section renders a proper title such as "Popular near you" or hide the section until localized content is available.
